title: Pets Roam the Consolidated Borders
description: The course pets used to jump between UI elements of the old layout, which the consolidated-border design no longer has. New logic: pets move around the empty areas of the UI, walk on top of border lines, climb, use a ladder, fire a grappling hook to reach a level higher, and may try to steal a chip.
summary: Pets no longer line up on the footer: the survey can treat a surface as a frame around open room, the course names its ground as border lines (card frames, the chips at a card's foot, the footer line), a press on a pet inside an overview card is the pet's, the label of a topic card's title chip is what that topic's pet may try to steal, and the reserved strip above the footer is gone. Survey vectors (Python reference extended) 71 of 71; course pets suites pass; three Playwright pets specs pass on the release rehearsal. Open: travel between levels on the overview and an actual chip theft were not observed, a title label is rarely reachable for the prank and carrying a chip away is not built, mischief on a quiz page never starts because rows span the whole stage, and most of the pets Playwright project was not rerun. Details: 🐾️pets-on-border-lines.md.
